source.quote: As of May 31, 2026, we employed approximately 141,000 full-time employees, of which approximately 49,000 were employed in the U.S. and approximately 92,000 were employed internationally.

payroll.label: the fiscal 2026 total compensation of our median global employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The fiscal 2026 total compensation of Mr. Magouyrk was $627,472,419, the fiscal 2026 total compensation of Mr. Sicilia was $256,606,752 and the fiscal 2026 total compensation of our median global employee was $94,740.

notes: Employees: approximate full-time count at May 31, 2026 from the FY2026 10-K (the proxy's pay-ratio section counts approximately 143,950 employees on the same date, including other than full-time staff). Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or personnel costs, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2026 is used; it is the same year as the head count. Oracle identified the median from base salaries and wage rates of its May 31, 2026 employee population, excluding about 5% of employees in eleven countries. The ratios are 6,623:1 (Magouyrk) and 2,709:1 (Sicilia).
